description: This Java class `ShareProductData` models and encapsulates data related to share products in a financial application. It includes properties such as identifiers, share counts, pricing, currency, charges, and accounting configurations. The class provides multiple static factory methods for creating instances with various levels of detail, including templates, with account details, and lookup methods. It also includes methods to determine if accounting is enabled and to retrieve the accounting rule type ID.

classes.name: ShareProductData
classes.description: Represents detailed data about a share product including identifiers, pricing, shares, charges, currency, accounting, and configuration options. Provides various static factory methods for different instantiation scenarios and methods to check accounting state.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Creates a new ShareProductData instance with detailed properties, allowing full specification including accounting details.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template ShareProductData with options for currency, charges, and accounting mappings, used as a base for creating specific share product instances.

methods.name: withAccountingDetails
methods.description: Returns a copy of the given ShareProductData with specific accounting mapping details attached.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a lightweight ShareProductData instance with only id and name, used for identification or reference purposes.

methods.name: generic
methods.description: Creates a simple ShareProductData with only id, name, shortName, and totalShares.

methods.name: hasAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if the accounting rule indicates accounting is enabled, based on the accounting rule's ID.

methods.name: accountingRuleTypeId
methods.description: Returns the integer ID of the accounting rule used for this share product.
